Summary: New requisition is unpublished by default and Publish makes it appear on the careers site
StepsToReproduce:
1. Go to https://ai-recruit-eight.vercel.app/login.
2. Log in as Admin using QA test account.
3. Open OryFolks Careers Site.
4. Confirm new job is absent from open positions.
5. Click 'Publish' in Job Management.
6. Reload Careers Site.
ExpectedResult: Job is absent from the careers site before Publish; it becomes visible immediately after Publish (BR-02).
ActualResult: New job created with publishedToCareers=false (absent from careers site). Upon clicking Publish, job appears on /api/jobs/public immediately.
Comments: Verified publishJob lifecycle and public careers endpoint filtering. Working as expected.

Summary: Publish then immediately Unpublish removes the job from the careers site at once
StepsToReproduce:
1. Go to https://ai-recruit-eight.vercel.app/login.
2. Log in as Admin using QA test account.
3. Publish the job and confirm it is visible on Careers Site.
4. Immediately click 'Unpublish'.
5. Reload Careers Site.
ExpectedResult: The job disappears from the careers site immediately after Unpublish, with no caching delay.
ActualResult: Job disappears from /api/jobs/public immediately after unpublish with zero caching delay.
Comments: Verified unpublishJob lifecycle. Immediately sets publishedToCareers=false.
